prerequisites: Finite element theory, solid mechanics course

learning_outcomes.text: At the end of the course, students should be able to model and simulate the dynamic behavior of a mechanism with deformable parts, in order to check that it meets specifications.
Use dynamic simulation software to simulate a mechanism whose operation and/or performance depend on the deformability of certain parts.

syllabus_topics: Simulation of a first mechanism to check its mechanical strength
Justification of the settings to be made on NX to perform a modal analysis
Simulation of a mechanism where deformability is necessary for operation
Simulation of a mechanism where deformability may be detrimental to expected performance
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
